issues.description: `MemoryRegionArray` keeps an `Inv` implementation for the same `count <= LEN` predicate already enforced by its new type invariant.
issues.rationale: The reviewed revision defines `Inv::inv` and `type_inv` with the identical predicate. The collaborator explicitly requests deletion, and the next commit removes `impl Inv` plus the dependent `InvView` while retaining the type invariant. Under `implement-inv-for-models`, one predicate must use one invariant mechanism; keeping both duplicates proof paths and can let their definitions drift.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus not executed. Inspected the original review commit, subsequent fix, final merged head, complete archived discussion, and complete live remote discussion.
